title: The Hostage Peace
text: After a winter of knives in the dark, the magistrates have had enough. As the old Houses did when the city was young, the House with the most Scions must send a Ward to a rival Seat and take one back. The magistrates call it a peace. Everyone else calls it hostages.

options.label: Name the House you will exchange Wards with, trusting them with your blood.

outcomes.text: At midnight the Wards change Seats in a closed carriage. Now each House has someone at the other's table, and each table is a little more careful.

options.label: Bribe the magistrates to look elsewhere; peace can be bought another way.

outcomes.text: The magistrates find another way to keep the peace. It involves gibbets.

options.label: Refuse; no child of this House sleeps under another roof.

outcomes.text: The magistrates write your refusal into the record, and the other Houses read it aloud at dinner.
